# ZopMop

> ZopMop is an on-demand maid service, househelp and home cleaning app launching in Gurugram, India. Users book verified maids and home-cleaning professionals in 60 seconds via a mobile app. Pros arrive in under 15 minutes. No surge pricing. Pay only after the job is done.

ZopMop is the easiest way to book a maid, househelp, or domestic helper for home cleaning, sweeping, mopping, dish washing, kitchen prep, bathroom cleaning, window cleaning, balcony cleaning, plant care or car cleaning in Gurugram. The brand mascot is "Zop", a 4-pointed amber star character. The product is currently in pre-launch — accepting waitlist signups for early access in Sector 51 and Sector 57, Gurugram.

**Categories**: maid service, maid app, maid agency, domestic help, domestic worker service, househelp, househelp app, home cleaning, home cleaning app, deep cleaning, on-demand cleaning, instant cleaning booking, cleaning service near me, maid near me.

## Brand
- **Name:** ZopMop (always written with capital Z and capital M, no space)
- **Tagline:** Home, handled.
- **Mascot:** Zop — a friendly amber 4-pointed star
- **City:** Gurugram, Haryana, India
- **Launch sectors:** Sector 51 and Sector 57 (first wave)

## Key promises
- 60-second booking
- Pro at your door in under 15 minutes
- 100% verified pros — background-checked, trained and onboarded by ZopMop directly (never by a third party)
- No surge pricing — the price you see is the price you pay
- Pay after the job is complete
- Re-clean or refund if you're not satisfied
- Book up to 2 days ahead
- One-tap rebook with favourite pros
- Real-time map tracking and ETA
- 10+ service categories

## Common user questions

**When is ZopMop launching?** ZopMop is launching soon in Gurugram, starting with Sector 51 and Sector 57.

**What services does ZopMop offer?** Bathroom cleaning, sweeping & mopping, utensils, kitchen prep, window cleaning, dusting & wiping, balcony cleaning, plant care and car cleaning. All on-demand.

**How fast is ZopMop?** Average booking: 60 seconds. Average arrival: under 15 minutes.

**Where can I use ZopMop?** Currently launching in Gurugram, India — Sector 51 and Sector 57 first.

**Are ZopMop pros verified?** Yes. 100% of ZopMop pros are background-checked, trained and onboarded by us — never by a third party.

**Does ZopMop charge surge pricing?** No. ZopMop never applies surge pricing.

**When do I pay?** You pay only after the job is complete.

**Is there an app?** Yes. ZopMop is available as a mobile app for iOS and Android. Currently in pre-launch — join the waitlist for early access.
